idea-plugin.name: Git Helper
idea-plugin.description:
Batch select multiple Git repositories under a workspace root, then switch them to a target branch or create a new branch based on a source branch. Local uncommitted changes are preserved and remote branches are force-synced before switching.
批量选择工作区下多个 Git 仓库，执行：
1. 切换到指定分支：以远程代码为准强制同步后，再把本地改动文件覆盖回去
2. 基于源分支新建目标分支：先同步源分支远程代码，再新建分支并覆盖本地改动

Welcome to reward.

Feedback & Reviews
Found a bug or have an idea? Please leave a review on the JetBrains Marketplace plugin page. Your feedback decides what ships next.
遇到问题或有功能建议，欢迎在 Marketplace 插件页留下评价。

Additional Information
Plugin ID: com.childeshu.githelper
Requires: Git command line available in PATH
Compatible with: IntelliJ IDEA 2024.1 - 2024.3 (build 241 - 243.*)
Local backup: ~/.git-helper-backup/ (created for each switch / create)
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0 (2026-11-18) - Initial release / 首个版本
  • Batch switch / create branches across multiple Git repositories under one workspace root. 工作区下多仓库批量切换分支、基于源分支批量新建分支。
  • Local uncommitted changes are preserved: tracked modifications are backed up before switching and restored afterwards. 切换前备份本地改动，切换后自动还原。
  • One-click "Sync from Remote" (fetch --prune + rebase) and "Push to Remote". 支持批量同步远程、批量推送。
  • Optional parallel execution (1 - 32 repos) with progress and per-repository logs. 可选多进程并行，带进度展示与分仓库日志。
  • Safer Git calls: 45s timeout, non-interactive credentials, UTF-8 output for non-ASCII branch names. Git 命令超时保护、禁用凭据弹窗、UTF-8 输出避免中文分支名乱码。
  • Entry points: Tools menu, main toolbar, navigation bar and the "Git 助手" tool window. 支持 Tools 菜单、主工具栏、导航栏与左侧工具窗口入口。
